releaseNotes:
1. Right Drawer Feeder Names: Removed English-to-Tamil conversion from the right drawer; raw feeder/file names render in English with responsive hyphen-based line breaks.
2. Right Drawer Feeders Backup & Restore: Dedicated Feeders database backup (.db), restore, and share options accessible directly from the drawer header for GIS feeder data.
3. OTA Update Size Display: Download size (MB/total MB) and package size clearly displayed before download, during downloading, and during APK package installation.
